name: DevRel Anomaly Detection (anomaly-detection)

parameters.query:
-- Anomaly detection: 3σ rule over 30-day baseline
-- For each platform, compute last-hour engagement vs 30d rolling average + stddev
-- AC-15: engagement > baseline + 3*stddev triggers alert
SELECT
  ae.platform,
  ae.content_id,
  COALESCE(cp.title, ae.content_id)  AS title,
  COALESCE(cp.url, '')               AS url,
  SUM(ae.metric_value)               AS last_hour_engagement,
  stats.avg_engagement,
  stats.stddev_engagement,
  stats.avg_engagement + 3 * COALESCE(stats.stddev_engagement, 1) AS threshold_3sigma
FROM analytics_events ae
LEFT JOIN content_pieces cp ON cp.id = ae.content_id
LEFT JOIN (
  -- 30-day baseline: hourly engagement aggregates
  SELECT
    platform,
    content_id,
    AVG(hourly_sum)    AS avg_engagement,
    STDDEV(hourly_sum) AS stddev_engagement
  FROM (
    SELECT
      platform, content_id,
      date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS hour,
      SUM(metric_value) AS hourly_sum
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE occurred_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
      AND event_type IN ('engagement', 'like', 'click', 'retweet', 'impression')
    GROUP BY platform, content_id, date_trunc('hour', occurred_at)
  ) hourly
  GROUP BY platform, content_id
  HAVING COUNT(hourly_sum) >= 24
) stats ON stats.platform = ae.platform AND stats.content_id = ae.content_id
WHERE ae.occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  AND ae.event_type IN ('engagement', 'like', 'click', 'retweet', 'impression')
GROUP BY ae.platform, ae.content_id, cp.title, cp.url,
  stats.avg_engagement, stats.stddev_engagement
HAVING SUM(ae.metric_value) > stats.avg_engagement + 3 * COALESCE(stats.stddev_engagement, 1)
ORDER BY last_hour_engagement DESC
LIMIT 5

nodes.name: Detect Anomalies (3σ)
nodes.notes: 3σ anomaly detection: content with last-hour engagement > 30-day baseline + 3*stddev. Returns top 5 anomalies. Uses analytics_events table directly (not materialized view for freshness).

nodes.name: Telegram Anomaly Alert
nodes.notes: Sends alert via Phase F alerts pipeline (Telegram bot). Alert format: 'anomaly: <content_piece> Nx baseline' as per spec AC-15.

notes: Phase V Part D — AC-15. Runs every 1h. Queries analytics_events for content with engagement > 30-day baseline + 3σ (3-sigma rule). Fires Telegram alert for each anomaly detected. Reuses Phase F alerts pipeline (Telegram bot). Activate after Tier 1 data starts populating (need 7+ days of baseline). See docs/specs/devrel-analytics-stack.md.
